# truefoundry_gateway_guardrails_config (Resource)

Manages the AI gateway guardrails configuration: which guardrails (e.g. from a `truefoundry_guardrail_group`) run on which requests. Applied as a `gateway-guardrails-config` manifest via `PUT /api/svc/v1/apply`. **The guardrails config is a tenant-wide singleton** — define at most one of this resource per control plane; an apply replaces all rules. Import the existing config with `terraform import truefoundry_gateway_guardrails_config.example gateway-guardrails-config`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The tenant-wide AI gateway guardrails config (singleton — define at most one):
# which guardrails run on which requests.
resource "truefoundry_gateway_guardrails_config" "guardrails" {
  name = "guardrails-config"

  rules = [
    # Content safety on both directions for the models of one region.
    {
      id = "region-content-safety"

      when = {
        target = {
          model = {
            condition = "in"
            values    = ["my-azure-openai/gpt-4o", "my-azure-openai/gpt-4.1"]
          }
        }
      }

      # References are <guardrail-group>/<guardrail-config> names,
      # e.g. from a truefoundry_guardrail_group.
      llm_input_guardrails  = ["region-guardrails/content-safety"]
      llm_output_guardrails = ["region-guardrails/content-safety"]
    },

    # Prompt shield on the input of everything a team sends.
    {
      id = "team-prompt-shield"

      when = {
        subjects = {
          operator = "or"
          in       = ["team:everyone"]
        }
      }

      llm_input_guardrails = ["region-guardrails/prompt-shield"]
      custom_error_message = "Request blocked by prompt shield."
    },
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the guardrails config (3-32 characters, lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens).
- `rules` (Attributes List) Guardrails rules. Every matching rule's guardrails run on a request. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Control plane ID of the gateway guardrails config.

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `id` (String) Identifier of this rule, unique within the config.
- `when` (Attributes) Requests this rule applies to; all given parts must match. An empty block matches every request. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--when))

Optional:

- `custom_error_message` (String) Message returned to the caller when a guardrail blocks the request.
- `llm_input_guardrails` (List of String) Guardrails run on the LLM input. References are `<guardrail-group>/<guardrail-config>` names. Omit the attribute (rather than an empty list) when unused.
- `llm_output_guardrails` (List of String) Guardrails run on the LLM output. References are `<guardrail-group>/<guardrail-config>` names. Omit the attribute (rather than an empty list) when unused.
- `mcp_tool_post_invoke_guardrails` (List of String) Guardrails run after MCP tool invocations. References are `<guardrail-group>/<guardrail-config>` names. Omit the attribute (rather than an empty list) when unused.
- `mcp_tool_pre_invoke_guardrails` (List of String) Guardrails run before MCP tool invocations. References are `<guardrail-group>/<guardrail-config>` names. Omit the attribute (rather than an empty list) when unused.

<a id="nestedatt--rules--when"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.when`

Optional:

- `metadata` (Map of String) Request metadata key-value pairs to match.
- `subjects` (Attributes) Matches the calling subject by FQN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--when--subjects))
- `target` (Attributes) Matches the request target; the given conditions are OR-ed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--when--target))

<a id="nestedatt--rules--when--subjects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.when.subjects`

Required:

- `operator` (String) How `in` and `not_in` combine: `and` or `or`.

Optional:

- `in` (List of String) Subject FQNs to match.
- `not_in` (List of String) Subject FQNs to exclude.


<a id="nestedatt--rules--when--target"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.when.target`

Optional:

- `mcp_servers` (Attributes) Matches the MCP server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--when--target--mcp_servers))
- `mcp_tools` (Attributes) Matches MCP tools per server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--when--target--mcp_tools))
- `model` (Attributes) Matches the model, as `<provider-account>/<model>` names. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--when--target--model))

<a id="nestedatt--rules--when--target--mcp_servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.when.target.mcp_servers`

Required:

- `condition` (String) Match semantics. One of: `in`, `not_in`.
- `values` (List of String) Values to match against.


<a id="nestedatt--rules--when--target--mcp_tools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.when.target.mcp_tools`

Required:

- `condition` (String) Match semantics. One of: `in`, `not_in`.
- `values` (Attributes List) MCP servers and their covered tools. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--when--target--mcp_tools--values))

<a id="nestedatt--rules--when--target--mcp_tools--values"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.when.target.mcp_tools.values`

Required:

- `enable_all_tools` (Boolean) Whether all tools of the server are covered.
- `name` (String) Name of the MCP server.

Optional:

- `enabled_tools` (List of String) Specific tools covered when `enable_all_tools` is false.



<a id="nestedatt--rules--when--target--model"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.when.target.model`

Required:

- `condition` (String) Match semantics. One of: `in`, `not_in`.
- `values` (List of String) Values to match against.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The guardrails config is a tenant-wide singleton; its import ID is the
# fixed string "gateway-guardrails-config".
terraform import truefoundry_gateway_guardrails_config.guardrails gateway-guardrails-config
```
